name: The St. Regis Hong Kong
positioning: St. Regis hotel in historic Wan Chai on Hong Kong Island, with interiors by designer André Fu, within easy walking distance of the Convention and Exhibition Centre and Victoria Harbour
best_for: Travelers attending events at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
Guests interested in French and Cantonese fine dining and butler service

facts.text: The hotel is in historic Wan Chai on Hong Kong Island.
The hotel is within easy walking distance of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre and Victoria Harbour.
The interiors reflect the vision of interior designer André Fu, conceived as a curated mansion in the heart of Wan Chai.
Butlers greet guests curbside and take them straight to their room for in-room check-in.
L'Envol is a French restaurant led by Chef Olivier Elzer.
L'Envol serves over 40 cheeses on a three-tiered trolley.
Rùn is a Cantonese restaurant led by chef Hung Chi-Kwong.
At Rùn, a tea master brews a welcome tea and a digestif tea tailored to each guest's preference.
The St. Regis Bar serves signature cocktails inspired by New York's subway and Hong Kong's tramline.
The Verandah Pool is a heated outdoor swimming pool.
The spa uses products from 001 Skincare London and 3LAB.
The Presidential Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic city and harbour views.

highlights.text: The hotel performs a champagne sabrage ceremony every day to mark the transition from day to evening.
The open-air Astor Terrace has a marble water feature leading to a 2.5-metre-high moon gate, a traditional element of Chinese gardens.
Bedrooms have a curved, winged headboard capped by white lacquer panels reminiscent of traditional Wan Chai shop shutters.
At Afternoon Tea, guests choose their own savouries and sweets from a dim sum-inspired trolley.
The St. Regis Bar's Canto Mary, its take on the Bloody Mary, uses chen pi (dried tangerine peel), Kowloon soy sauce and Chinese five-spice.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service; Hong Kong International Airport is approximately 39.3 km away.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing and a formal atmosphere that may not suit all travelers.
